get_waveform_from_audio_file: get the waveform and sample rate from a WAV, FLAC, or OGG audio file
convert_waveform_sample_rate_mono: convert a waveform to a target sample rate, mono channel, or normalized volume
get_fbank_features_from_audio: extract mel-filter bank features from a WAV or FLAC audio file using PyKaldi or TorchAudio
get_features_or_waveform_from_path: get speech features from an .npy file or waveform from a .wav/.flac file by path
build_TTSSpectrogram_module: build a PyTorch module that computes spectrogram magnitude from a waveform tensor using FFT
